objects.name: PowerShell
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution. (Citation: Here Is Why PowerShell Logging Matters) PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. Adversaries can use powershell.exe -EncodedCommand to hide the intent of a script from casual inspection.

external_references.description: reference without an external_id is not an ATT&CK id

objects.name: A Group That Is Not A Technique
objects.description: intrusion-set objects are skipped silently: the importer only materializes attack-patterns.

objects.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
objects.description: Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents on the system or in transit. This is common behavior that can be used across different platforms and the network to evade defenses.

objects.name: Obfuscated Files or Information (second copy)
objects.description: A duplicate T1027 object. The first occurrence must win and this one must be reported and skipped.

objects.name: A Technique With No ATT&CK Id
objects.description: No mitre-attack external reference at all, so there is no id to name a chunk file with. This object must be skipped with a warning.

objects.name: A Revoked Technique
objects.description: Revoked objects are historical and must not be imported.
